description: Apply a list of raw Google Docs API batchUpdate request objects (insert/replace text, formatting, etc.) to a document. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Apply raw Google Docs API batchUpdate requests to an existing document by id - insertText, replaceAllText, updateTextStyle, insertTable and the rest - passed through verbatim. The low-level structural edit surface for documents, covering changes beyond what the higher-level verbs reach.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with replies, the raw batchUpdate response replies array.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the edit requests were applied. This is a write action that structurally modifies the document.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Apply structural edit requests to a Google Docs document.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, or requests is empty/not a list of dicts, or a request object is malformed per the Docs API. gsuite.not_found: the document id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a non-empty list of valid Docs API request objects. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
